hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command '$j = git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/journal.md; $h = git rev-parse HEAD; $m = git status --porcelain docs/journal.md; if (-not $m -and $j -ne $h) { @{systemMessage="Le dernier commit ne touche pas docs/journal.md : lancez /cloture."} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }'
